ns2:course.label: Lang Literacy in EC Educ I
ns2:course.description: Basic principles, techniques, and materials for the emergent literacy classroom. Emphasizes linguistic and cultural factors in culturally diverse settings. Concurrent enrollment in CI 420. Prerequisite: EPSY 236; admission to the Early Childhood Teacher Education Program.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Concurrent enrollment in CI 420. Prerequisite: EPSY 236; admission to the Early Childhood Teacher Education Program.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Early Childhood Education or Early Childhood Education major(s) or minor(s).
ns2:course.sectionCappArea: Restricted to Admitted Teacher Ed Student students.
